messages:
maya: postmortem follow-up for the GPU autoscale incident. quick owners + plan so we can close.

maya: ACTIONS:
1) quota default buffer -> set to 11% and add per-team override (owner: ron)
2) scheduler knobs -> test adaptive packing start=0.66, min=0.59 (owner: sam)
3) headroom test -> 48h soak with burst injection (owner: lia)
4) preflight middleware -> reject requests if projected_headroom < 6% (owner: ron + ops-bot)
5) canary sequence -> smoke 20m, soak 2h, full 6h with rollback hook (owner: ops-bot)
6) runbook -> add "post-surge playbook" and an alert for quota_pressure_rate>2/min (owner: maya)

maya: timeline: PRs by Thu, sim start Fri, canary next Mon, observe 5 business days post-rollout.

ron: i'll take quota + middleware. opening PR and tests.

sam: will run perf vs cost matrix; if cost delta >7% at 0.66 we fallback to hybrid.

lia: need traces. maya please post S3 path and i'll bootstrap the sim job.

maya: s3://redwood-incidents/autoscale/2026-03-spike-traces.tar.lz4 / anonymized 5-day window.

ops-bot: ci: quota-buffer PR created -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4357

ron: PR up, feature flag=false by default, will enable only in canary.

lia: sim started on dev-grid, uploading logs to /sim-results/3301234567.tar.gz. initial 12h: buffer cut eviction tail ~68%, p99 +2.5% worst-case.

sam: perf sweep running: packing=[0.6,0.66,0.7], preempt_backoff=[300,800]. posting matrix when done.

maya: proposed canary abort: eviction_rate>1/min OR p99 uplift>12% OR cost_delta>9%.

ops-bot: canary-runner: initiated canary on prod-canary-9 (id: cr-3301234567).

ops-bot: canary: full stage complete -> PASS. metrics: eviction_rate=0, p99+1.9%, cost_delta+3.8%.

maya: great. next: ron merge after 2 approvals, sam finalize knob recommendation, lia upload final sim report, maya update runbook and create closure ticket.

ron: merging now.

sam: final rec: adaptive start=0.66, min=0.59, cost_guard=6%.

lia: final report uploaded: https://drive.redwood/sim-reports/3301234567-final.pdf 

maya: scheduling weekly 15-min pulse checks for 3 weeks (week1 ron, week2 sam, week3 lia). if clean, i'll mark actions done in the postmortem. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
